collection.title: SEAT Toledo 1991 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A SEAT Toledo 1991 to 1999 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
